  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: triage_upstream_classify (and thus workflow_failure_heal.py) runs unconditionally in the upstream repository.
  WHY: The script runs the helper before verifying whether GITHUB_REPOSITORY is the upstream repository, so it runs unnecessarily and may fail in restricted environments. (Source severity: NIT.)
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:566-570 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The staging step reads GITHUB_REPOSITORY and CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_UPSTREAM_ROUTING_ENABLED without `:-` defaults under `set -euo pipefail`.
  WHY: test_support_staging_uses_trusted_checkout_not_pr_head sets neither variable, so bash aborts with "unbound variable" outside this repository's CI. Production sets both variables, so production is unaffected. (Source severity: NIT for all three.)
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:210-211 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment "Only the Claude pool credential step uses OIDC" above `id-token: write` is stale.
  WHY: The "Route upstream-managed check failure" step also needs the grant through request-report-identity. Narrowing the permission would turn every routed report into upstream_route outcome=fail_open reason=identity_unavailable. (Source severity: NIT for both.)
